Trump Warns Iran of Annihilation, Then Confirms Talks

U.S. President Donald Trump issued a warning of "annihilation" to Iran during a speech at the United Nations, but later confirmed that the U.S. had met with Iranian mediators for three hours. Iran's military condemned Trump's remarks as "tool for domestic propaganda." Meanwhile, Iran reportedly "toughened" conditions for ending the war after a U.S. deal collapse, according to a Guards spokesman. Tehran also set conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. In response to fuel shortages, Iran cut office hours and expanded remote work. Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West oil pipeline, and Gulf states discussed a security framework.
